From the microscopic marvels to the colossal beasts, *Super Animale* brings the natural world right to your fingertips!

Whether you are curious about extreme athleticism or biological oddities, this book acts as a window into nature's super-stars, presenting stunning images, detailed facts, and vital statistics for every creature featured.

Through engaging descriptions and factual data points for each animal, this book guarantees that you will never look at wildlife the same way again. It is the perfect resource for sparking an early love of science and natural history.
